title: 기준 모델 C2MS의 학습 조건 선별: 가중치 EMA, 학습 연장(300에폭), 분광 손실
hypothesis: training conditions alone can close the QB gap to U2Net+PAKAN (RR PSNR -0.22 dB, SAM +0.14 deg): an EMA of the weights (26: +0.089 dB on the original), a longer cosine schedule, or a spectral (1 - cosine) loss improves C2MS

arms.C2MS: C2MS, 150 epochs (53 procedure); the online weights reproduce the 53 control, the EMA weights test EMA alone
arms.C2MS_L300: C2MS, 300 epochs (same cosine 1e-4 -> 1e-6 over 300 epochs); online = longer schedule, EMA = longer schedule + EMA
arms.C2MS_SAM: C2MS, 150 epochs, + spectral_weight x mean(1 - cosine) on the original batch; online = spectral loss, EMA = spectral loss + EMA
arms.C2MS (53): 53 C2MS QB seed 42, the comparison control (not retrained)

screening: seed 42 only; candidates that improve over the 53 C2MS control are repeated with seeds 43-44 after approval
precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
loss: per-pixel MSE on the original batch + 1.0 x per-pixel MSE on the 2x coarser pairs (53 C2MS) + spectral_weight x mean over pixels of (1 - cosine of predicted and GT band vectors) on the original batch
ema: shadow copy of the weights updated after every applied optimizer step (26: beta 0.99, starts equal to the initial weights, float states averaged, integer states copied); validated every epoch and selected separately (best_ema.pt); never fed back to training
selection: online: minimum original-scale validation MSE of the online weights including epoch0 (best.pt); EMA: minimum original-scale validation MSE of the EMA weights including epoch0 (best_ema.pt); earliest exact tie
sensor_operators: 54 prepare.py SENSORS QB entry (MS GNyq 0.34/0.32/0.30/0.22, PAN 0.15, phase 2), the same coarse-pair construction as 53 prepare.py (checked before training)

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 (common/evaluation_protocol, QB), single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB; fixed before training
judgement.primary: each of the six candidates (C2MS-EMA, L300, L300-EMA, SAM, SAM-EMA; C2MS online as reproduction) vs the 53 C2MS seed 42 control: v2.3 label
judgement.reproduction: the C2MS online weights should match the 53 C2MS seed 42 within seed noise (same code lineage, data, seed and schedule)
judgement.expansion: a candidate labelled 개선 with RR PSNR gain >= 0.06 dB is proposed for seeds 43-44; the goal reference is U2Net+PAKAN QB RR 38.520 dB / SAM 4.439 / ERGAS 3.698
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse-scale validation

limits: the 53 control is a separate run (same code lineage, data, seed and schedule)

constraints.training: approved by the user 2026-10-23 (seed 42 first; 3 seeds only for candidates that improve)
